faq.a: Any UNC undergraduate, any major, any year. We're co-ed and interest in entrepreneurship matters more than experience.

faq.q: Do I need a startup or business background?
faq.a: No. Members come from CS, business, design, pre-med, journalism and more. Curiosity and drive are what we look for.
